rationale: This mutation eliminates the -$18.3k cash deficit by extending 2.0x-3.5x Town Shop contract deliveries through Day 30 with maturation-gated seed procurement, repairing the inverted land expansion trigger (uncultivated_plots <= 1) while slashing early hiring hurdles to $80 to front-load a 10-hand workforce across 28-36 plots. It institutes a high-margin two-tier liquidation hierarchy (raising the shed relief trigger to >=90% with an absolute 0.85x floor, while capturing >=1.08x cyclical price peaks), eliminates the phantom 4-unit Wheat reserve when holding zero livestock to accelerate Day 1-4 expansion, and optimizes worker transit via cluster harvesting (>=2 crops before shed transit).
